title: Practice 2: Dates and years in real sentences

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Федор говорил строителям о невозможности ломать срок окончания постройки, назначенный на первое ___ (январь).
exercises.why: Dates and years in real sentences — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 73, 75.  ·  «In denoting the time of an event (in answering the question "when?") the date and the month are both in the Genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 75.
exercises.context: Dates and years in real sentences (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 73, 75)
